reason: The dry soybeans must be gathered before they can be cooked, and the lined basket is intended for harvests.
expectation: The basket will hold the harvested soybeans for preparation.

effect: The soybeans are gathered but remain in their pods, so they need preparation before cooking.
reaction: The harvest connects the storm-surviving row to the meal.
reason: I need to find how the gathered pods can be prepared for cooking.
expectation: The inspection should reveal how to shell or otherwise prepare the beans.

effect: The inspection automatically shelled the pods, leaving dry soybeans ready for cooking.
reaction: The cloth’s use as a clean catch surface makes sense.
reason: The beans need thorough cooking, so I’ll put them in the prepared solar cooking pot.
expectation: The beans will enter the pot, possibly with water included in the cooking step.

effect: The beans needed soaking first; the compatibility feedback completed that preparation automatically.
reaction: The soaking step makes sense, though I had tried cooking them too soon.
reason: The soaked beans are now ready for the cooking vessel.
expectation: The beans will cook thoroughly in the pot.

effect: The soybeans are thoroughly cooked; the stew still needs potatoes and fresh lettuce.
reaction: The separate bean-cooking step makes the food preparation clearer.
reason: The potatoes need harvesting before they can join the cooked beans.
expectation: The basket will hold the harvested potatoes for preparation.

effect: The potatoes are harvested, washed and cut, ready to join the cooked beans.
reaction: The substantial harvest makes the earlier bed preparation feel consequential.
reason: The prepared potatoes can now go into the pot of cooked soybeans.
expectation: The potatoes will cook with the beans to make stew.

effect: The potatoes and beans are cooked into stew; fresh lettuce remains to be gathered and served.
reaction: The second heating gives the potatoes their own sensible cooking step.
reason: The lettuce tray has fresh outer leaves, and the lined basket is used to harvest them.
expectation: The basket will hold fresh lettuce leaves for the meal.

effect: The lettuce is harvested and washed, ready to serve with the stew.
reaction: Leaving the centre growing is a practical touch.
reason: The washed lettuce and finished stew are the two components of the meal.
expectation: This will serve the stew with fresh lettuce.

effect: Serving the washed lettuce alongside the stew completed the meal and the chapter.
reaction: The contrast between crisp leaves and warm stew gives the harvest a satisfying payoff.

mostWorthwhile.text: Harvesting the potatoes was the most worthwhile moment: the substantial yield made the earlier work on the bed feel consequential.

leastWorthwhile.text: Shelling the pods felt fairly routine, although the cloth's role as a clean catch surface was clear.

surprise.text: I tried to cook the dry beans immediately, but the feedback revealed that they needed soaking first and completed it automatically.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; even the less obvious cloth was used to catch the shelled beans.

continue.text: I would continue: the meal gave the survival and growing work a tangible payoff, and I would be curious to see what happens to the specimens.
